description: Draws one reported financial metric in the chat as an interactive chart: its history for one company, or several companies side by side for one fiscal period. Call it when the user asks to see or plot a metric such as revenue, net income or EPS, or when that chart is itself the answer. Show at most one card per answer. Never call it to collect data for your own analysis: where the chat app draws cards it answers with one line, not the rows. GetFinancialFact and CompareFinancialFact return the figures.

fiscalPeriod.description: FY or Q1..Q4. One company: optional filter. Several companies: the period compared (default FY).

fiscalYear.description: Comparing several companies: the fiscal year, as the calendar year each period ends in, e.g. 2025. Not used for one company.

tickers.description: One ticker for a history, or several (max 25) to compare them; a listing on another exchange is MIC:TICKER (XPAR:AIR).
